stem.archstudio.filters_counts_help: Choice counts include the other filter, across all floors and sections.
stem.archstudio.filters_empty: No blocks match. Try another shape or material, or clear the filters.
stem.archstudio.filters_empty_build: This build has no blocks yet. Place a block or open a starter design.
stem.archstudio.filters_empty_replay: This replay step has no blocks. Choose another step in the timeline.
stem.archstudio.filters_grid_help: Filters affect the 3D view. The floor grid continues to show the full editing floor.
stem.archstudio.filters_hidden_help: Floor or section settings hide some matches.
stem.archstudio.filters_reveal: Reveal matches across floors and sections
stem.archstudio.filters_remove_help: Removes matches across all floors and sections of the live build. Undo restores them.
stem.archstudio.filters_replay_help: Return to the live build to remove matching blocks.
stem.archstudio.filters_all_help: Choose a material or shape before removing blocks.
stem.archstudio.filters_keep_help: Closing this panel keeps your filters applied.
